entities.name: Ministry of Defence
entities.description: Union ministry responsible for the defence of India and its armed forces: the Army, Navy, Air Force, Coast Guard, and all defence production and research bodies. Works through five departments.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Department of Defence
entities.description: The senior department of the Ministry of Defence; deals with policy for Defence and defence estates, cantonments, National Cadet Corps, Coast Guard and inter-service organisations, and coordinates the ministry as a whole.

entities.name: Department of Military Affairs
entities.description: Created in 2020 to bring the Army, Navy and Air Force, and the Territorial Army under a single department; headed by the Chief of Defence Staff as ex-officio Secretary, and drives jointness/theaterisation and service-specific (non-capital) procurement.

entities.name: Department of Defence Production
entities.description: Handles indigenous production of defence equipment, oversight of the Defence Public Sector Undertakings (DPSUs) and Ordnance Factory successor companies, and defence exports/self-reliance (Atmanirbhar Bharat) policy.

entities.name: Department of Defence Research and Development
entities.description: Runs India's defence research and development through DRDO; its Secretary is ex-officio Chairman of DRDO.

entities.name: Department of Ex-Servicemen Welfare
entities.description: Deals with the welfare, resettlement and pension policy of ex-servicemen and their dependants, through bodies such as the Kendriya Sainik Board and the Directorate General of Resettlement.

entities.name: Indian Army
entities.description: India's land warfare service; the largest of the three armed forces, organised into seven operational/training Commands plus tri-service formations.
entities.hq: Integrated Defence Staff HQ / Army HQ, New Delhi

entities.name: Indian Navy
entities.description: India's maritime warfare service, responsible for the Arabian Sea, Bay of Bengal and wider Indian Ocean; organised into three Commands.

entities.name: Indian Air Force
entities.description: India's aerial warfare service, organised into five operational and two functional (Training, Maintenance) Commands.
entities.established: 1932-10-08 (as Royal Indian Air Force); current form since 1950-01-26

entities.name: Headquarters Integrated Defence Staff
entities.description: Tri-service planning and coordination staff supporting the Chief of Defence Staff/Chairman of the Chiefs of Staff Committee; runs joint doctrine, force development, intelligence and administration for tri-service commands and agencies.

entities.name: Andaman and Nicobar Command
entities.description: India's first tri-service unified command, guarding the Andaman & Nicobar Islands and the eastern approaches to the Malacca Strait.

entities.name: Strategic Forces Command
entities.description: Tri-service command that manages and administers India's strategic (nuclear-capable) missile and air assets under the Nuclear Command Authority.

entities.name: Defence Cyber Agency
entities.description: Tri-service agency for military cyber-security and cyber-warfare, drawing officers from the Army, Navy and Air Force.

entities.name: Defence Space Agency
entities.description: Tri-service agency responsible for operating space-related military assets and coordinating with ISRO on defence space needs.

entities.name: Defence Intelligence Agency
entities.description: India's primary military intelligence agency, coordinating intelligence for and from the three Services and tasking tri-service assets such as the Defence Image Processing and Analysis Centre.

entities.name: Territorial Army
entities.description: A volunteer reserve force that supports the regular Army, mostly with part-time citizen soldiers who retain civilian jobs.

entities.name: Northern Command
entities.description: One of the Indian Army's operational/training commands, headquartered at Udhampur.

entities.name: Western Command
entities.description: One of the Indian Army's operational/training commands, headquartered at Chandimandir.

entities.name: Eastern Command
entities.description: One of the Indian Army's operational/training commands, headquartered at Kolkata.

entities.name: Southern Command
entities.description: One of the Indian Army's operational/training commands, headquartered at Pune.

entities.name: South Western Command
entities.description: One of the Indian Army's operational/training commands, headquartered at Jaipur.

entities.name: Central Command
entities.description: One of the Indian Army's operational/training commands, headquartered at Lucknow.

entities.name: Army Training Command (ARTRAC)
entities.description: One of the Indian Army's operational/training commands, headquartered at Shimla.

entities.name: Western Naval Command
entities.description: One of the Indian Navy's three area commands, headquartered at Mumbai.

entities.name: Eastern Naval Command
entities.description: One of the Indian Navy's three area commands, headquartered at Visakhapatnam.

entities.name: Southern Naval Command
entities.description: One of the Indian Navy's three area commands, headquartered at Kochi.

entities.name: Western Air Command
entities.description: One of the Indian Air Force's operational/functional commands, headquartered at New Delhi.

entities.name: Eastern Air Command
entities.description: One of the Indian Air Force's operational/functional commands, headquartered at Shillong.

entities.name: Central Air Command
entities.description: One of the Indian Air Force's operational/functional commands, headquartered at Prayagraj.

entities.name: Southern Air Command
entities.description: One of the Indian Air Force's operational/functional commands, headquartered at Thiruvananthapuram.

entities.name: South Western Air Command
entities.description: One of the Indian Air Force's operational/functional commands, headquartered at Gandhinagar.

entities.name: Training Command
entities.description: One of the Indian Air Force's operational/functional commands, headquartered at Bengaluru.

entities.name: Maintenance Command
entities.description: One of the Indian Air Force's operational/functional commands, headquartered at Nagpur.

entities.name: Indian Coast Guard
entities.description: Multi-mission maritime force responsible for coastal and offshore security, search-and-rescue, marine environment protection and anti-smuggling in Indian waters; distinct from the Navy, under the Ministry of Defence.

entities.name: Border Roads Organisation
entities.description: Builds and maintains roads, bridges, airfields and other infrastructure in India's border regions, mostly through the General Reserve Engineer Force (GREF), for both military and civilian use.

entities.name: Directorate General Defence Estates
entities.description: Manages defence land and cantonments across India, and administers the network of Cantonment Boards.

entities.name: Cantonment Boards
entities.description: Aggregate of India's Defence-administered local self-government bodies for military garrison towns (cantonments); civic administration in many cantonments is being progressively handed over to neighbouring municipalities since 2024, shrinking the count.

entities.name: Defence Research and Development Organisation
entities.description: India's central defence R&D agency; designs and develops missiles, aircraft avionics, armaments, radars, electronic-warfare systems and other military technology through a network of laboratories organised into technology clusters.

entities.name: Aeronautical Systems Cluster
entities.description: Unmanned air vehicles, aero gas-turbine engines and airborne surveillance systems.

entities.name: Armament & Combat Engineering Systems Cluster
entities.description: Armaments, explosives and land-combat/engineering vehicles.

entities.name: Electronics & Communication Systems Cluster
entities.description: Electronic, electro-optical and laser-based sensors, radars and communication systems.

entities.name: Micro Electronic Devices, Computational Systems & Cyber Security Cluster
entities.description: Microelectronics, computational systems and cyber-security.

entities.name: Missiles & Strategic Systems Cluster
entities.description: Missile and strategic-systems development (e.g. Agni, Akash, BrahMos-linked work).

entities.name: Naval Systems & Materials Cluster
entities.description: Six naval laboratories including NPOL and NSTL, plus materials research.

entities.name: Soldier Support Systems Cluster
entities.description: Soldier equipment, life sciences and high-altitude/extreme-environment support.

entities.name: Military Engineer Services
entities.description: Inter-service engineering organisation that builds and maintains infrastructure (barracks, airfields, hospitals, roads, dockyards) for the Army, Navy and Air Force, combining military Engineer officers with civilian engineering cadres.

entities.name: Armed Forces Medical Services
entities.description: Tri-service medical corps providing healthcare to the Army, Navy and Air Force and their families, including battlefield medicine and military hospitals.

entities.name: Armed Forces Medical College
entities.description: Premier tri-service medical training institution, established 1948, that trains doctors and nurses for the Armed Forces Medical Services.

entities.name: Defence Accounts Department
entities.description: Financial-advice, payment and accounting organisation for the Ministry of Defence and armed forces, headed by the Controller General of Defence Accounts (CGDA), who is the Principal Accounting Officer for defence expenditure.

entities.name: National Cadet Corps
entities.description: Tri-service youth voluntary organisation that gives school and college students basic military training and a sense of discipline and national service; not a reserve of the armed forces.

entities.name: Sainik Schools Society
entities.description: Registered society under the Ministry of Defence that runs the Sainik Schools network (co-run with state governments), preparing students for entry to the National Defence Academy and other officer-training institutes.

entities.name: National Defence Academy
entities.description: Tri-service pre-commissioning training academy for cadets of the Army, Navy and Air Force before they proceed to their respective service academies.

entities.name: Indian Military Academy
entities.description: Premier officer-training academy of the Indian Army, commissioning permanent-commission officers into the Army.

entities.name: Defence Services Staff College
entities.description: Tri-service staff college that trains mid-career officers of the Army, Navy, Air Force and friendly foreign militaries in staff duties and joint operations.

entities.name: National Defence College
entities.description: India's highest seat of strategic studies, training senior defence-service and civil-service officers (and friendly foreign officers) for top-level strategic leadership roles.

entities.name: Manohar Parrikar Institute for Defence Studies and Analyses
entities.description: Government-funded autonomous think tank conducting research on strategic, defence and security affairs and training civilian, military and police officers.

entities.name: Kendriya Sainik Board
entities.description: Apex central body (with State/District Sainik Boards under it) for welfare and resettlement of ex-servicemen, war widows and their dependants.

entities.name: Directorate General of Resettlement
entities.description: Runs resettlement, re-employment training and placement programmes for retiring and retired defence personnel.

entities.name: Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme Organisation
entities.description: Runs the contributory health scheme providing medical care to ex-servicemen pensioners and their dependants through polyclinics and empanelled hospitals.

entities.name: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited
entities.description: Aerospace and defence PSU designing, manufacturing and overhauling combat aircraft, helicopters, UAVs, engines and avionics; Maharatna status (Oct 2024).

entities.name: Bharat Electronics Limited
entities.description: Defence electronics and aerospace PSU making radars, communication systems, missile electronics, naval systems and avionics; Navratna status.

entities.name: Bharat Dynamics Limited
entities.description: Prime production agency for India's guided-missile programmes (Akash, Prithvi variants, anti-tank guided missiles, torpedoes) built in partnership with DRDO.

entities.name: BEML Limited
entities.description: Heavy-equipment PSU (earthmoving, rail & metro, defence & aerospace); historically a defence PSU, now administratively a multi-ministry enterprise with close defence-production ties. Government holding ~54%.

entities.name: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited
entities.description: India's premier warship and submarine builder for the Indian Navy (destroyers, frigates, corvettes, diesel-electric submarines); Navratna status.

entities.name: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Limited
entities.description: Kolkata-based defence shipyard building and repairing naval and commercial vessels; granted Navratna status June 2026.

entities.name: Goa Shipyard Limited
entities.description: Builds frigates, offshore patrol vessels and patrol boats for the Navy and Coast Guard; capacity limited to vessels under 15,000 DWT.

entities.name: Hindustan Shipyard Limited
entities.description: India's second-largest shipyard; ship building/repair and submarine construction and refits; transferred from the Ministry of Shipping to the Ministry of Defence in 2010.

entities.name: Mishra Dhatu Nigam Limited
entities.description: Manufactures superalloys, titanium and special steels for aerospace, defence and atomic-energy use, including materials for Chandrayaan-3 and Gaganyaan.

entities.name: Advanced Weapons and Equipment India Limited
entities.description: Ordnance Factory Board successor company (est. 2021) making field guns, gun carriages, small arms and artillery; runs the former Field Gun, Gun Carriage, Gun & Shell, Rifle and Small Arms Factories.

entities.name: Armoured Vehicles Nigam Limited
entities.description: Ordnance Factory Board successor company making tanks, armoured vehicles and tank engines; runs the former Heavy Vehicles Factory, Engine Factory Avadi, Vehicle Factory Jabalpur and Ordnance Factory Medak.

entities.name: Munitions India Limited
entities.description: Ordnance Factory Board successor company making ammunition, explosives, propellants and cordite; runs the former Ammunition Factory Khadki and Cordite Factory Aruvankadu among others.

entities.name: Yantra India Limited
entities.description: Ordnance Factory Board successor company making machine tools, metal/steel components and foundry items; runs former Metal & Steel Factory and Grey Iron Foundry sites.

entities.name: India Optel Limited
entities.description: Ordnance Factory Board successor company making optoelectronic devices and precision optical instruments; runs the former Opto Electronics Factory Dehradun.

entities.name: Gliders India Limited
entities.description: Smallest Ordnance Factory Board successor company, making parachutes and related aircrew support equipment, from the former Ordnance Parachute Factory Kanpur.

entities.name: Troop Comforts Limited
entities.description: Ordnance Factory Board successor company making military uniforms, clothing and combat gear; runs the former Ordnance Clothing and Ordnance Equipment Factories.
